proposals.expected_effect: Provide a new, uncorrelated source of positive-edge spot trades during highly volatile/fast market regimes with no dependency on wallet tracking.
proposals.minimum_observation: 12 observation windows, 30 simulated trades, and verified profit factor >= 1.10.
proposals.rationale: By relying on direct on-chain liquidity indicators and execution spread divergence instead of individual wallets or raw price momentum, the bot can discover uncorrelated micro-arbitrage or slippage reversion opportunities that bypass copy-trading latency limits.
proposals.shadow_test: Simulate entry signals on tick data, recording spreads exceeding 3 standard deviations from the trailing 1-hour average. Record exit simulated prices, and measure simulated net P&L after subtracting typical priority fees, router fees, and 0.15% average slippage/impact. Stop shadow testing if cumulative hypothetical loss exceeds 10% of virtual allocation.

proposals.downside_risk: Execution delay (latency leakage) turning a theoretical net edge into a realized loss in highly competitive/crowded routes.

rejected_ideas.idea: Force automated execution frequency targets in the Strategy Laboratory to meet a minimum trades-per-hour quota.
rejected_ideas.reason: As defined in docs/STRATEGY_LAB.md, active does not mean forced trading. Forcing every strategy to trade under unfavorable market conditions would turn an activity target into a loss-generating quota and directly degrade the money-weighted net P&L after fees.

rejected_ideas.idea: Allow executing arbitrary Python scripts or code snippets proposed by AI strategy agents directly inside the live engine.
rejected_ideas.reason: This violates the platform's security boundaries and sandboxing principles. As structured in learnerbot/strategy_ai_proposals.py, AI proposals must remain strictly declarative data/hypotheses to prevent any execution of malicious code, secret extraction, or accidental deployment modifications.

summary: A complete, architecture-only strategy review of the trading bot repository and strategy cycle evidence. Because .strategy_cycle/evidence.json reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS, we strictly enforce the prohibition of any live or canary profitability claims. The core architecture of the Strategy Laboratory (strategy_lab.py) and the copy-trading engines (sibot.py and solana_sibot.py) is robust, providing clean sandboxing of shadow research. We propose shadow-testing existing built-in families (Cross Venue Net Arbitrage, Learned Route Replication, and SiBot Leader Copy) to gather out-of-sample metrics, alongside proposing a new uncorrelated spread-imbalance shadow strategy, ensuring that all live safety and capital gates remain fully intact.
